subject: D150 SYNC (4) per-device link and outage emulation, and D150 SYNC (3) device-side buffering and post-outage resync
label: READ-ONLY SURVEY of committed code at origin/main. No code was written, no cell was run, no sweep was posted. Every file:line below is read from `git show origin/main:<path>`, never from the working tree.
verdict: ABSENT (outage emulation), PARTIALLY BUILT (per-device link emulation, with no outage term)
verdict_one_line: The link is emulated per device as a CONSTANT (bandwidth, RTT, FIFO uplink). There is no outage emulation of any kind in the live2 harness; the single link-state field the arms can read is hard-coded True, the device-side outage buffer does not exist, and the one planner that implements the D150 SYNC (3) choice has never been called by any arm.
register_note: Marked at the point of use. READ = quoted from committed source. INFERRED = concluded from naming or absence of a grep hit, never from a filename alone. Every ABSENT claim below names the read site that could not be found.

D150_SYNC_3_4_5.SYNC (3): outage: the device answers alone and keeps its raw frames since the last confirmed sync (stated assumption); on reconnect the policy prioritises whose backlog to prefill (value + deficit), and for a question before catch-up chooses question-first (pre-outage history + recent frames, D54), wait, or leave to the device, with backlog ordering oldest-first for append-only KV
D150_SYNC_3_4_5.SYNC (4): links are emulated in the harness per device (bandwidth, RTT, outages; identical across arms), with a SYNTHETIC swept outage model (10 / 30 / 60 / 120 s; independent vs correlated), labelled synthetic since no outage traces exist (P6)
D150_SYNC_3_4_5.SYNC (5): outage scenarios are evaluated AFTER the core v2 grid (memory sweep, 3 s deadline)
